reviews.comment: Take this professor! She was extremely understanding when I emailed her about a personal emergency and making up quizzes. Clear grading criteria and emphasizes what you need to know. Learned a lot without too much stress, even though it was condensed class in a Summer Session. Put in the effort and you'll be in good shape with her as an instructor!

Loved this class! All online, super easy, and a great class to take over the summer! Just 13 quizzes and then a final that just used exact questions from the quizzes. Responded quickly to questions, and the class was well organized. I actually enjoyed learning the material in her class! would def take her again!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE HER!!! SOCI 220 was the best! The class was amazing! There was many assignments but she posted clear instructions and videos on how to do everything! she is extremely well and explains and teaching thing! She is so understanding and easy going! I highly recommend her class! Easy to do well if you complete the assignments and participate.
Professor Blazek is an amazing sociology professor! Take a course with her if given the chance

Professor Blazek was an amazing prof for sociology & I definitely would take her again. I loved how she structured her lectures, made the material very easy to understand. You do have to study because the only grades are midterm, final and final paper. She gives a very extensive review and it states exactly what will be tested so easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Blazek is amazing, her lectures are great, she explains every concept with examples and everything is understandable. Theres only 2 exams and 1 paper, so if you have to study a lot but she gives a review with every topic/question she will ask on the exam (100 question exams). Her class is easy, just pay attention and go to class!

The structure of the class was not my favorite at all. You're graded by 3 things, so it makes it harder for you to get an A. I wish there was more material in the class. The professor though is good at explaining and making you understand concepts.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Blazek is a really nice person, but I found the lectures extremely boring. There are only 3 grades total, midterm, final, and an essay, so you have to make sure you score good on everything. The reviews were just like the exam, which makes the exams easier.

This class was interesting and not very hard at all. I never watched the lectures, just read the slides and extra readings, and made an A. 5 discussion posts, 2 exams, and a final paper on whatever you want. She gives rly good feedback and the material kept me engaged all semester. Very good class!

I really enjoyed taking Social Problems with her, she seems to care about what she's teaching and went the extra mile to make sure we did too. Five discussion posts required out of 12 opportunities so you can choose what you want to write about, three exams, and a final paper.
